{{Quote|A stupid, useless battle in an increasingly violent and useless war.|[[Sha Koon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Purge: Seconds to Die">''[[Purge – Seconds to Die]]''</ref>}}
This '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist forces]] invaded the planet and a regiment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sha Koon]] were sent to take back the planet. The regiment was intended to act as the core of a locally-raised [[Militia/Legends|militia]] to help retake the planet.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Sha Koon's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Baylis Archan]], as well as Sha Koon's entire command, were lost during the battle. An embittered Sha Koon considered the battle entirely unnecessary. However, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces were victorious in the end, and the battle was considered a prime example of the "militia model" of deploying small units of clone troopers to support larger planetary uprisings.<ref name="NEC" />
